name: Drei Tannen
beschreibung: Hotel Drei Tannen is located in the municipality of Tannheim in the Tannheimer Tal, in the region of Tirol. The surroundings are characterized by the Lechtaler Alpen and offer direct access to hiking trails and ski areas. The facilities include, among other things, a restaurant with Tiroler Küche, a sauna, and a wellness area. The rooms are decorated in light wood tones and some have a balcony facing the valley. The atmosphere is quiet and traditional, without trendy staging. The accommodation is primarily suited for hikers, families, and guests looking for an uncomplicated base for outdoor activities.
